blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The municipal government of Santa in this province has set a minimum farmgate price of P180 per kilogram for live hogs, aiming to protect local raisers while promoting fair pricing for meat vendors and consumers. Santa Mayor Jeremy Jesus “JJ” Bueno III issued Executive Order No. 178, Series of 2026, on Monday (Nov. 9), setting a uniform rate based on liveweight, with no weight brackets.
